options.content:
### OpenSky / Trafic aérien
**20 grandes compagnies · monde** · données API réelles · positions de moins de 5 min · collecte ≈ 96 s · UTC

panels.title: Avions observés · 5 min
panels.description: Avions distincts avec une position OpenSky datant de moins de 5 minutes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS avions FROM flight_current JOIN (VALUES ('ACA','Air Canada'),('CCA','Air China'),('ASA','Alaska Airlines'),('ANA','All Nippon Airways'),('AAL','American Airlines'),('BAW','British Airways'),('CES','China Eastern'),('CSN','China Southern'),('DAL','Delta Air Lines'),('EZY','easyJet'),('EJU','easyJet'),('EZS','easyJet'),('UAE','Emirates'),('IGO','IndiGo'),('LAN','LATAM Airlines'),('TAM','LATAM Airlines'),('LPE','LATAM Airlines'),('LNE','LATAM Airlines'),('LXP','LATAM Airlines'),('DLH','Lufthansa'),('QTR','Qatar Airways'),('RYR','Ryanair'),('SWA','Southwest Airlines'),('THY','Turkish Airlines'),('UAL','United Airlines'),('WZZ','Wizz Air'),('WMT','Wizz Air'),('WUK','Wizz Air')) AS airlines(code,name) ON upper(left(trim(callsign),3))=airlines.code WHERE source='live' AND position_at > now()-interval '5 minutes'

SELECT count(*) AS avions FROM flight_current JOIN (VALUES ('ACA','Air Canada'),('CCA','Air China'),('ASA','Alaska Airlines'),('ANA','All Nippon Airways'),('AAL','American Airlines'),('BAW','British Airways'),('CES','China Eastern'),('CSN','China Southern'),('DAL','Delta Air Lines'),('EZY','easyJet'),('EJU','easyJet'),('EZS','easyJet'),('UAE','Emirates'),('IGO','IndiGo'),('LAN','LATAM Airlines'),('TAM','LATAM Airlines'),('LPE','LATAM Airlines'),('LNE','LATAM Airlines'),('LXP','LATAM Airlines'),('DLH','Lufthansa'),('QTR','Qatar Airways'),('RYR','Ryanair'),('SWA','Southwest Airlines'),('THY','Turkish Airlines'),('UAL','United Airlines'),('WZZ','Wizz Air'),('WMT','Wizz Air'),('WUK','Wizz Air')) AS airlines(code,name) ON upper(left(trim(callsign),3))=airlines.code WHERE source='live' AND position_at > now()-interval '5 minutes' AND NOT on_ground

panels.title: Altitude moyenne · en vol
panels.description: Altitude barométrique des avions en vol observés récemment.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(baro_altitude)/1000 AS altitude FROM flight_current JOIN (VALUES ('ACA','Air Canada'),('CCA','Air China'),('ASA','Alaska Airlines'),('ANA','All Nippon Airways'),('AAL','American Airlines'),('BAW','British Airways'),('CES','China Eastern'),('CSN','China Southern'),('DAL','Delta Air Lines'),('EZY','easyJet'),('EJU','easyJet'),('EZS','easyJet'),('UAE','Emirates'),('IGO','IndiGo'),('LAN','LATAM Airlines'),('TAM','LATAM Airlines'),('LPE','LATAM Airlines'),('LNE','LATAM Airlines'),('LXP','LATAM Airlines'),('DLH','Lufthansa'),('QTR','Qatar Airways'),('RYR','Ryanair'),('SWA','Southwest Airlines'),('THY','Turkish Airlines'),('UAL','United Airlines'),('WZZ','Wizz Air'),('WMT','Wizz Air'),('WUK','Wizz Air')) AS airlines(code,name) ON upper(left(trim(callsign),3))=airlines.code WHERE source='live' AND position_at > now()-interval '5 minutes' AND NOT on_ground

panels.title: Dernière position · âge
panels.description: Âge de la position OpenSky la plus récente. Orange au-delà de 2 min, rouge au-delà de 5 min.

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM now()-max(position_at)) AS age FROM flight_current JOIN (VALUES ('ACA','Air Canada'),('CCA','Air China'),('ASA','Alaska Airlines'),('ANA','All Nippon Airways'),('AAL','American Airlines'),('BAW','British Airways'),('CES','China Eastern'),('CSN','China Southern'),('DAL','Delta Air Lines'),('EZY','easyJet'),('EJU','easyJet'),('EZS','easyJet'),('UAE','Emirates'),('IGO','IndiGo'),('LAN','LATAM Airlines'),('TAM','LATAM Airlines'),('LPE','LATAM Airlines'),('LNE','LATAM Airlines'),('LXP','LATAM Airlines'),('DLH','Lufthansa'),('QTR','Qatar Airways'),('RYR','Ryanair'),('SWA','Southwest Airlines'),('THY','Turkish Airlines'),('UAL','United Airlines'),('WZZ','Wizz Air'),('WMT','Wizz Air'),('WUK','Wizz Air')) AS airlines(code,name) ON upper(left(trim(callsign),3))=airlines.code WHERE source='live'

panels.title: Positions réelles · monde · 20 compagnies
panels.description: Une position par avion, fraîche de moins de 5 minutes. Survolez un point pour les détails.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(nullif(trim(callsign),''),icao24) AS "Indicatif",
            airlines.name AS "Compagnie",latitude,longitude,round(baro_altitude::numeric) AS "Altitude (m)",
            round((velocity*3.6)::numeric) AS "Vitesse (km/h)",
            position_at AS "Position UTC" FROM flight_current JOIN (VALUES ('ACA','Air Canada'),('CCA','Air China'),('ASA','Alaska Airlines'),('ANA','All Nippon Airways'),('AAL','American Airlines'),('BAW','British Airways'),('CES','China Eastern'),('CSN','China Southern'),('DAL','Delta Air Lines'),('EZY','easyJet'),('EJU','easyJet'),('EZS','easyJet'),('UAE','Emirates'),('IGO','IndiGo'),('LAN','LATAM Airlines'),('TAM','LATAM Airlines'),('LPE','LATAM Airlines'),('LNE','LATAM Airlines'),('LXP','LATAM Airlines'),('DLH','Lufthansa'),('QTR','Qatar Airways'),('RYR','Ryanair'),('SWA','Southwest Airlines'),('THY','Turkish Airlines'),('UAL','United Airlines'),('WZZ','Wizz Air'),('WMT','Wizz Air'),('WUK','Wizz Air')) AS airlines(code,name) ON upper(left(trim(callsign),3))=airlines.code WHERE source='live' AND position_at > now()-interval '5 minutes'

panels.title: Les 20 compagnies · avions observés
panels.description: Sélection fixe OAG Takeoff 2025. Compagnie déduite du préfixe OACI de l’indicatif. Principaux codes easyJet, LATAM et Wizz inclus ; couverture des filiales non exhaustive. Zéro signifie aucun avion observé récemment.

targets.rawSql: SELECT airlines.name AS "Compagnie", count(f.icao24) AS "Avions" FROM (VALUES ('ACA','Air Canada'),('CCA','Air China'),('ASA','Alaska Airlines'),('ANA','All Nippon Airways'),('AAL','American Airlines'),('BAW','British Airways'),('CES','China Eastern'),('CSN','China Southern'),('DAL','Delta Air Lines'),('EZY','easyJet'),('EJU','easyJet'),('EZS','easyJet'),('UAE','Emirates'),('IGO','IndiGo'),('LAN','LATAM Airlines'),('TAM','LATAM Airlines'),('LPE','LATAM Airlines'),('LNE','LATAM Airlines'),('LXP','LATAM Airlines'),('DLH','Lufthansa'),('QTR','Qatar Airways'),('RYR','Ryanair'),('SWA','Southwest Airlines'),('THY','Turkish Airlines'),('UAL','United Airlines'),('WZZ','Wizz Air'),('WMT','Wizz Air'),('WUK','Wizz Air')) AS airlines(code,name) LEFT JOIN flight_current f ON upper(left(trim(f.callsign),3))=airlines.code AND f.source='live' AND f.position_at > now()-interval '5 minutes' GROUP BY airlines.name ORDER BY 2 DESC,1

panels.title: Avions observés par minute
panels.description: Avions des 20 compagnies observés par minute. Les intervalles sans collecte ne sont pas des zéros.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute',position_at) AS time,count(DISTINCT icao24) AS "Observés", count(DISTINCT icao24) FILTER (WHERE NOT on_ground) AS "En vol" FROM raw_flight_states JOIN (VALUES ('ACA','Air Canada'),('CCA','Air China'),('ASA','Alaska Airlines'),('ANA','All Nippon Airways'),('AAL','American Airlines'),('BAW','British Airways'),('CES','China Eastern'),('CSN','China Southern'),('DAL','Delta Air Lines'),('EZY','easyJet'),('EJU','easyJet'),('EZS','easyJet'),('UAE','Emirates'),('IGO','IndiGo'),('LAN','LATAM Airlines'),('TAM','LATAM Airlines'),('LPE','LATAM Airlines'),('LNE','LATAM Airlines'),('LXP','LATAM Airlines'),('DLH','Lufthansa'),('QTR','Qatar Airways'),('RYR','Ryanair'),('SWA','Southwest Airlines'),('THY','Turkish Airlines'),('UAL','United Airlines'),('WZZ','Wizz Air'),('WMT','Wizz Air'),('WUK','Wizz Air')) AS airlines(code,name) ON upper(left(trim(callsign),3))=airlines.code WHERE source='live' AND $__timeFilter(position_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Pays d’immatriculation · avions observés
panels.description: Pays indiqué par OpenSky, distinct de la position géographique actuelle.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(origin_country,'Inconnu') AS "Pays", count(*) AS "Avions" FROM flight_current JOIN (VALUES ('ACA','Air Canada'),('CCA','Air China'),('ASA','Alaska Airlines'),('ANA','All Nippon Airways'),('AAL','American Airlines'),('BAW','British Airways'),('CES','China Eastern'),('CSN','China Southern'),('DAL','Delta Air Lines'),('EZY','easyJet'),('EJU','easyJet'),('EZS','easyJet'),('UAE','Emirates'),('IGO','IndiGo'),('LAN','LATAM Airlines'),('TAM','LATAM Airlines'),('LPE','LATAM Airlines'),('LNE','LATAM Airlines'),('LXP','LATAM Airlines'),('DLH','Lufthansa'),('QTR','Qatar Airways'),('RYR','Ryanair'),('SWA','Southwest Airlines'),('THY','Turkish Airlines'),('UAL','United Airlines'),('WZZ','Wizz Air'),('WMT','Wizz Air'),('WUK','Wizz Air')) AS airlines(code,name) ON upper(left(trim(callsign),3))=airlines.code WHERE source='live' AND position_at > now()-interval '5 minutes' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC,1 LIMIT 8
